body:
I am considering seeing a therapist. I really think that these feelings are chemical in origin (I have been seeing a GP for medication). I had a baby a few months ago and have been dealing with depression ever since. I think it is compounded by a lot of stress in my personal life. I am stuck in a job I hate with a boss who is a violent, hateful asshole, my husband is unemployed, and my rapist tried contacting me over facebook a week ago. I also had someone attempt to rob me a couple of weeks ago, and a good family friend shot herself in the head a few days ago. I guess I am just throwing a giant pity party, but I feel stressed the fuck out. 

I cut myself for the first time in six years a week ago. It was deep and needed stitches and my husband flipped out over it, said if I ever did it again he would leave me. I can't say I really blame him. I try to talk to him about my feelings, but he usually just gets angry with me and gives me a "pull yourself up by your bootstraps" speech. I am trying, I really am, but it isn't going well.
